identity.title: [v0.91.8][WP-09][provider] Add Kimi and current agentic model providers

values.summary: Added deterministic first-class provider profiles and preserved vendor identity across the shared HTTP transport for current Kimi, MiniMax, hosted Qwen, xAI/Grok, Mistral, Cohere, DeepSeek v4, Z.ai GLM-5, and Gemini 3.1 model lanes.
actual_changes: Added stable provider profile names, endpoints, and provider model identifiers for each expanded vendor lane.
Extended provider substrate vendor inference so shared transport does not collapse distinct vendor identities.
Added focused registry and substrate tests for deterministic identity and model selection.
Kept credentials, live calls, AWS/Bedrock, and OpenRouter routing out of the deterministic implementation lane.

actual_validation.purpose: Prove expanded provider identities, deterministic model identifiers, vendor inference, adapter redaction, and provider regression behavior.
Prove expanded provider identities, deterministic model identifiers, vendor inference, chat adapter request/response shapes, and legacy generic HTTP compatibility.
